name: faa-wildlife-strike-substantial-damage
description: Given only what is known when a wildlife strike is reported, will the aircraft be assessed as substantially damaged or destroyed (ICAO major damage)?
split_description: Fixed cut on INCIDENT_DATE, no random resampling: train 1990-01-01 to 2013-12-31; eval 2014-01-01 to 2018-12-31; holdout 2019-01-01 to 2022-12-31. No embargo is required inside the series because each row is one independent strike and every feature is fixed at strike time, so a later row cannot reveal an earlier label; the 2022-12-31 end cut is a reporting/validation lag buffer of about 3.7 years against a snapshot current to August 2026. Boundaries are frozen before any modelling.
